reviews.title: Brain training
reviews.text: So far, this seems easy, I think any brain excercise can be beneficial at any age. I have lost brain power in the past, due to not stimulating my brain enough and just partying & hanging around dumb people. I really believe you can build back your brain power quickly with this app. This app builds your brain with out you even realizing it-You think your just playing simple games. This is great for marijuana smokers as well, cuz it’s not extremely hard. You can build up what you lost. Especially short term memory loss.
